tagline: Pour sand, water, fire and plants. Keep boards here. A meeting wall of friends' worlds — no account.
description:
A falling-sand toy. Pick an element, paint with your finger, watch it run. Sand piles. Water finds a way down. Lava turns water to stone. Fire eats wood. Plants drink. Pause, undo, reset. Brush from a dot to a splash.

Boards you keep stay in this copy of the app, on this device. Name one to come back to it.

Want a public wall of worlds? Press Play together, then Invite in the bar above the app, and send the link. Friends land on the wall. Put a board up as a small card. Tap a card to open that world and look. Nobody needs an account.

An unofficial port of Sandspiel by Max Bittker. The original is a web toy with a public gallery. This copy is the pour, the private save, and a meeting wall instead.
